verdict.rationale: Floot ships an official remote MCP server. It is documented for Cursor, VS Code, Zed and any remote-MCP client, has a published tool set (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, create_checkpoint, generate_image), and is described by a discovery manifest at /.well-known/mcp.json (streamable-http, OAuth2, registered in the MCP registry) whose endpoint answered a live probe. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents using the server end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers
It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), not Floot credits.
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
Floot's only programmatic surface is its remote MCP server, published as a machine-readable discovery manifest at /.well-known/mcp.json
